item.title: Gunsmoke - The Hostage
item.description: Four convicts take Matt hostage on their way to Mexico.

item.title: The Waltons - The Theft
item.description: The disappearance of some valuable silver pieces throws suspicion on one of the Waltons

item.title: Hawaii Five-O - Just Lucky, I Guess
item.description: A middle-aged mainland hardware salesman uses a prostitute, and then witnesses her murder by a mobster.

item.title: Matlock - The Target
item.description: When an assassination attempt on Matlock misses the mark but kills a judge, he, Cliff and Jerri look through old cases to determine who has it out for the famed attorney. Meanwhile, Matlock defends the man accused of the crime.

item.title: Perry Mason - The Case of the Brazen Bequest
item.description: Charles Cromwell, the president-elect of Euclid College, worries that some less than stellar moments from his past will be exposed when Maisie Freitag arrives at the college.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - The Younger Brother
item.description: Beaver decides to join the basketball team but finds himself trying to live up to Wally's performance. However, after not making the team, Beaver allows his family to believe that he did.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - Beaver, the Baby-Sitter
item.description: "When Wally has a previous engagement and is unable to babysit, Beaver fills in and quickly finds himself the object of a 10-year old's affection."

item.description: Toon In With Me - Trekkin' Old Dominion

item.title: Adam-12 - Log 174: Loan Sharks
item.description: While investigating the severe beating of a factory worker, Reed and Malloy uncover an extensive loansharking operation.

item.title: Adam-12 - Log 173: Shoplift
item.description: Malloy and Reed track down a young shoplifter who escapes custody and hides at the lair of an eccentric spiritualist whom she worships.
